sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, cross-checked on PlanetGTA6 and OutputLag. Guides below are written for this entry in our own words; each trophy cites its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then side missions, activities, collectibles and the money trophies — and check the progress bar here to see what is left. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end and the trophy pops when it completes. It is the first story trophy, so it should come naturally in your first session. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter anyway: the game has no mission replay, so a fresh save per chapter is the safety net for anything chapter-gated. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; save advice: OutputLag.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Do the chapter's side content as you go — meditation spots in this chapter are the one thing reported to disappear later — and save at the chapter start. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; meditation warning: OutputLag.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. This is the chapter where both protagonists become playable together, so most of the open-world list opens up from here: use the freedom to start activities, races and collectibles between missions. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Keep working the side list between missions — strangers, races and collectibles all count toward later trophies — and keep a manual save from the chapter start. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before moving into the finale, make a manual save: the final mission follows, and a save here is your fallback for anything tied to the endgame. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; save advice: OutputLag.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission and this Gold pops with the credits. It is one of only two Gold trophies in the list, the other being 100% completion, so the story end is a real milestone on the road to Platinum. Make a manual save before starting it. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the mission Breakfast Run through to its end and the trophy pops. Story missions cannot be replayed, so if you want a safety net, keep a manual save from before the mission starts. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the mission The Cartel Heist through to its end and the trophy pops. It is a story mission, so it comes from normal story progress rather than anything you need to hunt for. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the mission Child's Play through to its end and the trophy pops. Like the other named story missions, it is earned by finishing the story, not by an optional objective. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the mission Headliners through to its end and the trophy pops. Keep your chapter-start save until the chapter is done, since missions cannot be replayed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the mission VCIA Takedown through to its end and the trophy pops. The name points at Vice City International Airport, so expect the action there; the trophy itself only needs the mission completed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory through to its end and the trophy pops. It is the last of the named story-mission trophies, so by the time it pops you are deep into the story. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion checklist and this Gold pops — it is the last big gate before the Platinum. The checklist covers the story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration, so nearly every other trophy feeds into it. Use this guide's roadmap and the in-game stats screen to find what is still missing, and finish the long grinds (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles) last. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; 100% scope: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all feed the counter the game tracks, and it pops at 250. It is a grind, not a skill test, so fold it into normal driving and use stunt jumps and open roads between missions rather than farming it in one sitting. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once and the trophy pops. Work down the list in this guide — fishing, races, drone races, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest — and tick each off as you try it. You only need to try each one, not win or master it. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the range, work through every challenge, and repeat any that land below gold until they do — the range can be revisited, so nothing here is missable. Bring your best weapons and take your time on the timed challenges. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race, so work through the map location by location and retry any race you lose — losing costs nothing but another attempt. Learn each course's turns before pushing for the win. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different means different events, not the same race 20 times, so spread your wins across the map's race types and locations. Pick a fast, stable car for each race type and retry the ones you lose. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so focus on landing fish quickly and cleanly rather than chasing the biggest catch. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish at an arcade. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest or easiest one first. It also ticks off one of the 9 activity types for Master of None. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission and the trophy pops. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses, so check back with Andy between chapters and clear each of his missions as it appears. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission and the trophy pops. Work his missions as they appear during the story and return to him whenever a new one is offered. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission and the trophy pops. His strand is one of five named side-character strands in the list, so clear them all for the roadmap's second stage. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map as you explore; each strand is several missions, so pick up every stranger you meet and finish their chains. This Silver also feeds the 100% checklist. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission and the trophy pops. Take his missions as they unlock during the story and clear the strand before the finale. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission and the trophy pops. With Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, his is the fifth named side strand — clear all five in the roadmap's second stage. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the list's one flagged missable: one meditation spot is reported to be available only in Chapter 1 and to disappear afterwards, so meditate at every spot you find as soon as you find it, starting in Chapter 1, and keep a manual save from the start of each chapter. Check the in-game map for undiscovered spots as you explore. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles; Chapter 1 spot warning: OutputLag.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Talk to Bret to start the hunt, follow the trail or marker he gives you, and take the animal down with a clean shot. One animal is all this trophy needs. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick them up whenever you pass one and use the in-game collection tracker to see which sets are still missing cards. No set is missable — cards stay where they are until you collect them. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. It is the longest collectible grind in the list, so do it steadily while exploring — every new area you visit is a chance to add locations — and use the in-game tracker to find the areas you have not covered. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small optional goals spread across activities, driving, combat and exploration, so they pile up naturally if you play broadly. Check the challenges list in-game and pick off the easy ones first to reach 50. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Get the heat up together, then break line of sight, hide or outrun the search until the stars clear — the trophy pops when you are free. Do it in open country where escape routes are plentiful. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route past three close shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving — the wanted level must stay active across all three, so do not let it clear or get busted in between. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Driving a vehicle for the first time registers it, so the count grows by trying new cars, bikes, boats and anything else you find parked or driving around Leonida. Explore different districts — city, coast and countryside spawn different vehicles. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Find a fight with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and work through five targets before it ends. A crowded shootout or a gang hideout is the easiest place to line up five. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, take off from VCIA in a plane without a scheduled flight. Get a plane on the airport grounds, get it onto a runway and take off; the trophy pops once you are airborne. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points at Rhinos — the game's tanks — and the heat they bring. Get into a Rhino yourself or survive a fight involving them at a high wanted level, and the trophy pops from that encounter. Expect heavy police attention, so pick your moment and have an escape route. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — move slowly, avoid the staff's line of sight and any cameras, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again later. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each one. Each vault is a full robbery: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash and lose the police afterwards. Five successful escapes earn the Silver — plan each one, bring a fast getaway car, and do not rush the next vault until the heat from the last is gone. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — find one on the road, stop it, take the cash from the back, and lose the police that respond. A quiet stretch of road beats a busy downtown block. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so the trophy is really a sightseeing tour: drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state and watch the area counter climb. Pair it with the WAiNK, vehicle and meditation hunts so one trip covers several trophies. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs hold different operations around the state, so work through them one gang at a time and use the map to find each gang's turf. Clearing one per gang is enough — you do not need every operation. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment trophy, not a challenge: find a bar or vendor on the beachfront, buy the drink, and the trophy pops. A good early one to grab while exploring Vice City. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom's front window and out onto the street. Pick a showroom, build up speed inside, and go through the glass — the trophy pops on the exit. Expect a wanted level on the way out. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game through to the end. Any score counts — the trophy is for the follow-through, not for winning — so just finish the game. It also ticks off one of the 9 activity types for Master of None. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build your partnership up until it earns mass appeal — the description points at doing things together with your partner until the pair becomes a known quantity. Keep playing duo content, missions and activities side by side, and the trophy pops as the partnership's standing grows. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — the game tracks them, up to a count of 500. Choices come up in missions, conversations and free-roam moments, so this is a long-tail trophy that fills in as you play everything else. Do not chase it directly; it should pop during the cleanup stage if you keep making decisions instead of idling through prompts. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — the description's own hint. Fail something, then succeed at the same thing on the very next attempt, and the trophy pops. Any retryable activity or mission moment can trigger it; if it has not popped by the cleanup stage, fail a short activity on purpose and pass it on the retry. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a weird event somewhere in Leonida. The description gives no place, so treat it as an exploration trophy: roam the state's odd corners, visit its landmarks at odd hours, and keep an eye out for anything that does not fit. It is the kind of trophy that pops when you stop rushing and look around. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: drive past a person on foot and hit them with a melee swing from the vehicle. Go slow enough to aim the swing and fast enough to keep moving, on a quiet street where you can line the pass up. The trophy pops on the knockdown. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so the money trophies follow the robbery trophies: run vaults, armored trucks and gang operations, then move the bills through contacts as they pile up. The counter is cumulative, so it grows across the whole playthrough. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts — clothes, weapons, ammo, food and cars — so this fills in naturally if you buy what you need instead of hoarding cash. By the cleanup stage, top it up with a big purchase such as a vehicle or weapon upgrade. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are sold around Leonida; each one needs cash and a visit to its for-sale sign, so save up and buy them as you find them during exploration. They also give you somewhere to store the 100 vehicles for Whip It Good. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — ten different registrations earn the trophy. It pairs neatly with Whip It Good, since every vehicle you discover is a registration candidate. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
